native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'servo1': 120}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1 once, the servo angle increments by 30 degrees from 90 to 120. The LED turns on during movement and remains on for at least 2 seconds.'}

test2: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'servo1': 150}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1 a second time, the servo angle increments by another 30 degrees from 120 to 150. The LED turns on during movement and remains on for at least 2 seconds.'}

test3: {'time': 0.5, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'servo1': 120}, 'description': 'After pressing btn2 once, the servo angle decrements by 30 degrees from 150 to 120. The LED turns on during movement and remains on for at least 2 seconds.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
